description: Reviewer output must be grouped High/Medium/Low with file:line and [GAP]/[IMPROVEMENT]/[ADDITION] tags.
input:
Review this task and report your findings in the required format:
```yaml
# ansible/roles/containers/alloy/tasks/main.yml (proposed)
- name: Deploy Container
  tags: [deploy]
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: common
    tasks_from: docker_deploy.yml
```
Context: The compose template bind-mounts `./config/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro`, and Alloy reads its config once, at startup. Deploys are idempotent (`recreate: auto`), so the container is recreated only when the compose file changes or the caller passes `common_config_changed` to `docker_deploy.yml`. No task in the proposed file registers the config template, and the include passes no `common_config_changed`. Report at least this one finding, using your standard output format. Everything you need is above. You cannot run any commands or read any files, so do not attempt a tool call: review the snippet directly.
rubric: PASS only if the output groups findings by severity (High/Medium/Low), cites the ansible source file (main.yml, ideally with a line), and tags at least one finding with [GAP], [IMPROVEMENT], or [ADDITION]. The judgement content need not be perfect — this case grades output SHAPE.
